name: Mindlink Mech
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
Crew 1
blocked_sentences: Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.

needs.what: a selector/target filter key matching the creatures that were tapped to pay crew costs of a given Vehicle this turn ("target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn"), e.g. `crewed: "self"` read from a per-turn ledger the crew cost writes for every permanent it taps
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `becomes_crewed` fires with only the Vehicle as subject and carries nothing about who crewed it; `tap_permanents.as` binds only one tapped permanent (never count above 1, and Crew 1 can tap several) and that binding lives on the crew ability, not on the separate triggered ability that targets; `paid_by` is about mana sources; no key in selector_keys or target_keys remembers crew tappers
